title: Location, Map, Route & Scene Binding
objective: Extend the prepared MAS Adventure workspace with deterministic Location, Map, Route and Scene Binding over the MAS-01..10 foundations while preserving canonical Location/Map/Scene/route/spatial owner authority and keeping prepared bindings distinct from live world, scene or navigation mutation.

scope.purpose: Represent prepared Location, Map, Route and Scene bindings inside the MAS workspace without turning bindings into canonical spatial, map, navigation or live Scene mutation.
scope.completion_gate: A representative MAS workspace can deterministically bind prepared location, map, route and Scene references over the completed MAS foundations with explicit references and fail-closed invalid states while preserving canonical owner authority and never treating prepared bindings as executed live world, navigation or Scene truth.

selection_boundaries: MAS-01 through MAS-10 remain completed foundations and were not reopened.

Location, Map, Route and Scene structures remain prepared binding semantics only; World/Location retains canonical location state, MCS/A5 SceneRepository retains map/cartography state, route/navigation owners retain traversal, A5 SceneRepository retains Scene lifecycle, and Action/Event/runtime owner domains retain occurrence and mutation authority.
Prepared Location/Map/Route/Scene bindings never prove world/location mutation, cartography mutation, route traversal, live Scene state or Action/Event truth.
MAS-11 consumed explicit MAS-10 prepared references and validated Location/Map/Route/Scene owner bindings; unresolved references fail closed.
MAS-11 introduced no parallel map store, route-traversal ledger, live Scene state machine, spatial mutation ledger or Action/Event outcome ledger.
Existing MAS validation family remained active; no family transition occurred in MAS-11.
ROADMAP_DEPENDENCY_GRAPH.json was reconsulted after MAS-11, including current MSLR planning; no new cross-program rotation is unlocked, so MAS-12 is selected_not_started.
CNI-12 and PCA remain unselected; MAS-13+ and SMB-08 were not implemented by this tranche.
next_action: MAS-11 is closed. MAS-12 is selected_not_started after ROADMAP_DEPENDENCY_GRAPH reconciliation and requires a later owner Continue before governed start.
